MetaEntityWriteResult.title: 实体写入结果

description_en: Creates metadata entities in a batch. All entities within a batch must have the same entity type. This operation currently supports only custom types and extended table types, which represent databases and tables
description_zh: 批量创建元数据实体，同一批次需要为同一种类型，当前仅支持纯自定义类型和扩展表类型（对应Database/Table）
name: BatchCreateMetaEntities

fields.help_en:
The entity type. All entities in a batch must have the same type. The following types are supported:

Custom types, such as `custom_entity-biz_api`.

Extended table types. For example, if you have registered the `custom_dw-table` metadata entity type, you can create objects of the corresponding `custom_dw-database` (database) and `custom_dw-table` (table) types
fields.help_zh:
实体类型, 统一批次须一致，支持
纯自定义类型，如custom_entity-biz_api
扩展表类型，如果注册了元数据实体类型 custom_dw-table，支持创建对应的数据库类型 custom_dw-database 和 数据表 类型 custom_dw-table的对象
fields.name: entity_type

fields.help_en: The entity name. The name can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_). It must start with a letter and not exceed 64 characters
fields.help_zh: 实体名称，由大小写字母、数字、下划线组成，必须以字母开头，最长64字符
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The entity attributes. Complex values must be serialized into a JSON string
fields.help_zh: 实体属性，复杂值需要序列化为JSON字符串
fields.name: attributes

fields.help_en:
The custom attribute values. The key is the identifier of the custom attribute, and the value is a single-element list.
<notice>The custom attributes used here must be created in advance by using the CreateCustomAttribute API. For example, after you create a custom attribute with the ID `custom-attribute:owner_name`, you can configure the custom attribute by setting this parameter to {'owner_name': ['Bob']}.></notice>
fields.help_zh:
自定义属性值，key为自定义属性标识，value当前仅支持单值。
<notice>这里用到的自定义属性，需要通过CreateCustomAttribute API预先创建，比如通过API创建ID为 `custom-attribute:owner_name`的自定义属性后，这里可以配置 {'owner_name': ['Bob']}完成自定义属性配置</notice>
fields.name: custom_attributes

parameters.help_en: An entity list. You can create up to five entities in a batch. All entities in the batch must have the same `EntityType`
parameters.help_zh: 实体列表，最多5个；同一批次必须为同一种entityType
parameters.name: entities

Results.description_en: A list of results for the batch creation operation. This list provides the success status and any error messages for each individual entity in the request
Results.description_zh: 实体写入结果列表；逐条返回创建是否成功及失败原因

items.description_en: The result of a single entity creation within the batch

Results.title_zh: 实体写入结果列表；逐条返回创建是否成功及失败原因

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful. This parameter returns `true` even if creating some entities fails. To determine the outcome for each entity, check the `Success` and `ErrorMessage` fields in the `Results` array
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功；部分实体失败时仍返回true，逐条结果见Results[].Success和Results[].ErrorMessage
Success.title_zh: 请求是否成功；部分实体失败时仍返回true，逐条结果见Results[].Success和Results[].ErrorMessage
